answer: Coordination-Beacon Pricing. Each epoch, an identity must broadcast a beacon on a shared timing channel; the slot it occupies is priced by the number of distinct identities already active in that window. Slot prices follow a basalt-hard schedule: cost rises with occupancy and never resets downward within an epoch. An attacker running N sock puppets pays the integral of that rising price across all N slots, not a flat per-identity fee.
